description: This file contains unit tests for various SwiftUI view components related to application settings in an macOS app. It defines test functions that instantiate views, configure mock data, and access their body properties to verify correct rendering. It covers settings screens such as cron, config, debug, general, sessions, instances, permissions, about, voice wake, and skills.

classes.name: SettingsViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of SwiftUI tests for verifying the rendering of various settings views.
